may.note: The lowercase modal verb must not use the May calendar.

march.note: The movement verb must not use the March calendar.

miss.note: The verb senses (long for / avoid in context) must not use a beauty-pageant title image.

press.note: The push verb must not use the newspaper/Press image.

South.note: Book 3 lesson 45 uses South Dakota; do not use a south-pointing compass.
